title: Technology Stack & Integration Management | BOF
description: BOF manages ELD, TMS, accounting, payroll, GPS, load-board, EDI/API, user access, and integration handoff records for trucking operations.
html:
Integration control

Technology Stack & Integration Management

Fleet data is scattered across ELDs, TMS tools, GPS, accounting, payroll, load boards, storage, and email. BOF tracks the handoff so every system has an owner, access rule, data source, and exception path.

Technology Fragmentation Record

SystemData It HoldsBOF Control
ELD / telematicsHOS, location, odometer, events, vehicle diagnosticsDriver readiness, PM intervals, safety review, and route context.
TMSLoad, lane, customer, rate, dispatch statusLoad-to-cash record and owner follow-up.
Accounting / payrollInvoice, AR, AP, settlement, payroll basisRevenue readiness and driver pay math.
Documents / storagePOD, BOL, COI, policy, packet, image proofEvidence binding and retention governance.

Integration Clearance Path

  1. Map system owner. Each tool has an admin, business owner, and access gate.
  2. Classify handoff. API, export, manual upload, email, or portal workflow is recorded.
  3. Find broken fields. Missing IDs, mismatched load numbers, stale driver status, or duplicate records are flagged.
  4. Close with proof. Sync status, audit log, import result, or owner approval clears the gap.
